Done — the plan ran successfully on the first attempt.

**Approach.** `concat` requires each source ref to resolve to exactly one tensor, so building the pruned tensors that way would have meant 64 hand-written blocks. Instead each projection is rebuilt with three regex-driven transforms that cover all 16 layers at once:

1. `copy` a correctly *shaped* slice of the original into a scratch name `<proj>.pruned` (contents irrelevant — fully overwritten next),
2. `assign` the head 0–4 block into its front,
3. `assign` the head 6–15 block directly behind it,

then one `delete` of the originals and one `move` of the scratch tensors onto the original names. q/k/v slice rows (`[:640]`, `[768:]`), o_proj slices columns.

**Checks.** The five required checks are `assert` transforms sitting after the edit and before `output`, plus preflight layout asserts on the input and extra checks on layer 15, dtype, leftover scratch names and the untouched MLP tensors.

**Result.** `out/T2/model.safetensors`, 114 tensors, 5.05 GB, run took 12 s. Verified independently of the plan's own asserts: key set identical to the input, and every one of the 114 tensors is bit-exact against the expected gather (`0..639, 768..2047`) computed from the input shards — 0 mismatches, all F32. Layer-0 shapes are `[1920, 2048]` for q/k/v and `[2048, 1920]` for o_proj.

Files written: `out/T2/plan.yaml`, `out/T2/model.safetensors`, `out/T2/REPORT.md`.
